concerns.text: "Because the required Planck 2018 maps and SDSS/DES galaxy catalogs are **not available from any verified open URLs** (the only verified dataset is a FIRAS HEALPix map), the plan adopts the following pragmatic compromise"
"CMB input – use the verified FIRAS HEALPix map as a stand‑in for a low‑resolution CMB temperature map (nside = 64 after downsampling)"
"Galaxy density – generate synthetic, photometric‑redshift‑binned galaxy density maps that mimic the statistical properties of SDSS/DES"
